title: BMA executor process types
description: v1.1 process.* streaming (v1.1 §3) and its additive file transfer, package install, PTY and Git credential modes.

StdinMode.description: process.start stdin mode. Empty or "closed" closes stdin at start; "open" keeps it open for process.write.

StderrMode.description: process.start stderr mode. "merge" redirects stderr into stdout at the OS level so one cursor covers both.

IOMode.description: process.start io_mode. "pty" runs the command on a 24x80 pseudo-terminal: stdout is the PTY output, stdin writes go to the PTY and close_stdin is rejected. Requires process.pty.

FileTransferDirection.description: File transfer direction relative to the machine.

ProcessFileTransfer.description: Replaces argv: the executor moves one file between the machine and the process BMA file endpoint and reports the outcome in ProcessState.file_transfer. Requires process.file_transfer.

ProcessPackageInstall.description: Replaces argv: the executor installs packages with a fixed command it builds itself, streaming the package manager output as the process output. apt installs from the machine's configured (official) sources with the executor's own privileges; pip (--user) and npm (global under the workload user's ~/.local) run as the workload user. Package names are plain names only: no options, versions, paths or URLs. Requires process.package_install.

FileTransferResult.description: Ended file transfer outcome: the uploaded path and digest, the downloaded digest, or an error.

SessionOutputReport.description: One session output an ended process left: its path relative to the session's outputs directory, the sha256 digest of its content on the machine, and whether its upload went through.

path.description: Path relative to the session's outputs directory, with / separators.

digest.description: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> of the file's content on the machine.

uploaded.description: The platform stored this content (or refused it for good: too large, quota, scratch name).

ProcessState.description: Result of process.start/interrupt/terminate and one process.list entry. ended_at (RFC 3339, executor clock) is set once the process is no longer running; reason explains a "failed" state (for example "timeout"). A spawn failure never creates a state: it is the process.start error with data.reason "spawn_failed".

data.description: Base64 bytes from from_cursor to next_cursor.

session_outputs.description: Contract 2.5.0. Only on a read that reports an ended process of an agent session (metadata agent_session_id) on an executor with session_files: the outputs of that session the executor found changed since their last upload when the process ended, after it tried to upload them (retrying transient failures within its bound) and before it answered. uploaded=false means the upload has not gone through yet: the executor keeps retrying on its periodic scan, and a later read of the same ended process tries again and reports what is still pending. digest is the content the session left at path on the machine. Absent: the executor reports nothing (an older executor, or a process of no agent session).

session_memory.description: Only on a read that reports an ended process of an agent session on an executor with session_files.memory_writeback. Contract 2.901.0. Memory writeback reports (ADR-0110) the executor has not delivered yet for this session, each delivered once: every path of a read_write memory store whose change did not land as the agent left it. Absent or empty: nothing to report.

SessionMemoryReport.description: Contract 2.901.0. One memory path whose writeback did not land as the agent left it (ADR-0110). outcome conflict: the store changed since the session last saw it, the store's content replaced the session's copy; rejected: a memory rule refused it (message says which and what to do), the file stays and is sent again when it changes; delete_refused: more than 50 deletions of the store in one sync, none was sent and the files were restored; reset: the store's directory or its marker could not be trusted, the directory was restored from the store and nothing was written back.

path.description: The memory path (leading /); empty for delete_refused and reset, which concern the whole store.

message.description: What happened, written for the model.
